entity.name: Zain Dana Harper
entity.description: Independent researcher and toolmaker operating as a sole proprietor in Kent, Washington. Builds verifiable local-first compilers, AI evaluation harnesses, rendering engines, and open archival tools, publishing methods, data, and null results openly.

projects.name: BuildLang
projects.description: Deterministic systems and GPU programming language (buildc 1.15.0) with algebraic effect types, 12 CPU and GPU backends, certified e-graph superoptimizer prototype, BuildDB/BuildQL (qdb), and BuildTeX checked PDF typesetting.

projects.name: CMMNS
projects.description: Site-agnostic browser extension and archival CLI capturing any webpage (cmmns.page/1, Schema.org, RSS/Atom, JSON data islands) and social threads into daylight.sidecar/1 and manifest JSONL records with SHA-256 provenance verification.

projects.name: Flywheel
projects.description: Local-first accountable AI evaluation and verification workbench with model-neutral gateway, Rowan router, Three-Plate verification oracle, engine-receipt/1 trails, default-deny agent grants, and local RTX 4090 model forge. Source-available under FSL-1.1-MIT (converts to MIT after two years).

projects.name: The Playground (Superframe)
projects.description: Deterministic rendering, simulation, and multi-medium creative engine (DX12, Vulkan, WebGPU, C++23 native core) with spectral optics, biomechanical tree dynamics, and 6-DOF physical-AI simulation. Source-available under FSL-1.1-MIT (converts to MIT after two years).
